autoconnect_help: Put on your headset to connect. Audio follows you. End session turns Autoconnect off.
bootstrap: Connect the Quest by USB once and allow USB debugging to set up wireless control.
authorize: Put on the headset and allow USB debugging from this PC.
wake: Wake the headset and connect it to the same network as this PC.
stale_inventory: Showing the last recorded software versions.
matching_help: Install the WiVRn version that matches the running PC server.
confirm_channel: The Meta Store and GitHub editions are separate apps. This installs the managed GitHub edition.
confirm_disconnect: Turning off the hotspot will disconnect the current VR session. Continue?
headset_settings: Other headset settings live in the WiVRn app on the headset.
error_interrupted: The operation was interrupted. Refresh to check the current state.
error_headset_unreachable: The headset could not be reached.
error_unauthorized: USB debugging has not been authorized.
error_wivrn_missing: WiVRn is not installed on the headset.
error_version_mismatch: The WiVRn versions do not match.
error_apk_unavailable: The running PC version has no matching APK in this system build.
error_apk_integrity: The APK could not be verified.
error_install_verify_failed: The installed version could not be verified.
error_downgrade: This update would downgrade the headset app. Choose a matching PC version first.
error_connection_timeout: The headset did not connect to WiVRn.
error_wireless_failed: Wireless control could not be enabled.
error_no_wifi_address: The headset did not provide a Wi-Fi address.
error_inventory_failed: The software inventory could not be refreshed.
error_update_check_failed: The latest release could not be checked.
error_audio_restore_failed: The previous audio device is no longer available.
error_desktop_failed: The VR desktop could not start.
error_settings_failed: The saved settings could not be applied.
error_save_failed: The saved settings could not be applied.
error_session_active: Finish the current VR session before installing an update.
